versions.note: no custom image build — pip install lmcache in the stock SGLang image

setup_steps: pip install lmcache (0.5.1, c_ops loads against CUDA13)
sed patch lmc_radix_cache.py: self._mode = LMCacheMode.MP -> IP
render lmcache config with remote_url sagemaker-hyperpod://$NODE_IP:9200, use_layerwise: true
procedure: store 934-token prefix via /generate -> rollout restart SGLang pod (wipes L0/L1) -> replay identical prefix on fresh pod

telemetry.note: 768 cached tokens on a pod started cold after restart -> KV can only have come from the ai-toolkit L2 daemon

notes: SGLang reaches ai-toolkit L2 via LMCache IP mode (NOT HiCache/Mooncake). IP mode forwards the full config incl remote_url to the same SageMakerHyperPodConnectorAdapter the vLLM path uses.
use_layerwise: true is REQUIRED — SGLang IP store_layer asserts a layerwise GPU connector (assert_layerwise_gpu_connector); without it store_kv fails with AssertionError.
MP->IP is a one-line source patch (lmc_radix_cache.py line 139); MP mode reads only mp_host/mp_port and does not forward remote_url.

No custom image needed: stock lmsysorg/sglang (CUDA13) + pip install lmcache (CUDA13 wheel is the PyPI default). Earlier 'CUDA 12 vs 13' blocker was from grafting the dynamo image's CUDA-12 lmcache; pip-installing fresh resolves it.
Same type:File shm mount + PYTHONHASHSEED=0 + save_unfull_chunk + uid-1000 gotchas as the vLLM path.
3rd of 3 frameworks proven on HyperPod ai-toolkit L2 (dynamo, llm-d, sglang).
